title: Free Online Tools That Don't Upload Your Files or Need Sign-Up
content:
Updated 25 October 2026

Quick answer: These are free everyday tools that work entirely in your browser: a QR code generator whose codes never expire, a PDF toolkit to merge, split and reorder pages, a PDF signer, a photo converter for HEIC, file-size limits and removing location data, a resume builder and an invoice maker with free PDF downloads, a subscription tracker with renewal reminders, a meeting planner across time zones, a password generator with a safe breach check, and a word counter. None of them upload your files, ask you to sign up, add a watermark or limit how often you use them.

We built these because the same complaints keep coming up about "free" online tools. QR codes that stop working when a trial ends. Resume builders that charge at the download button. PDF sites that cap you at two tasks a day and keep your documents on their servers. E-signature services that let you send three documents, ever. Photo converters that need your private pictures uploaded first. Each tool here fixes one of those problems, and all of them follow the same four rules.

Our Four Rules

  1. Your files stay on your device. Everything runs in your browser. Once a tool has loaded you can turn on airplane mode and it still works.
  2. No account, ever. Nothing to sign up for, and no email address asked for.
  3. No watermark, trial or paywall. What you make is yours to download in full.
  4. No limits. Use them as often as you like. The only limit is your device's memory.

Where a tool remembers something for you, such as your resume, invoice details or subscription list, it is stored only in your own browser, and each tool has a button to clear it.

  • Merge, Split and Reorder PDFs Free Without Uploading Them (No Daily Limit). Merge files, drag pages into order, rotate or delete pages, extract a range, split every page into its own file, and turn photos into a PDF.
  • How to Sign a PDF for Free Without an Account (No 3-Document Limit). Draw, type or upload your signature, add the date, initials or text, and download the signed copy.
  • Free Resume Builder With a Free PDF Download (No Paywall at the End). Three clean, ATS-friendly layouts, saved as you type, with PDF, Word and plain-text downloads.
  • Free Invoice Generator: No Sign-Up, No Watermark, PDF in Seconds. Invoices, receipts and quotes with your logo, tax and discounts, and automatic numbering.

  • Convert HEIC to JPG, Shrink Photos and Remove Location Data, Without Uploading. Convert iPhone photos, shrink them under a file-size limit such as 100 KB, resize them, and remove hidden GPS location, camera and date data.
  • Free QR Code Generator That Never Expires (No Sign-Up, No Trial). QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contact cards, email, phone and WhatsApp, as PNG or SVG.

Money, Work and Security

  • Subscription Tracker: Find Forgotten Subscriptions and Get Reminded Before Renewals. See what you really spend a year, spot what you hardly use, and get calendar reminders before renewals and free trials end.
  • Meeting Time Zone Planner: Find a Time That Works in Every City. Find the hours that suit every city, with daylight saving handled, and send the times or a calendar invite.
  • Strong Password and Passphrase Generator, Plus a Safe Breach Check. Random passwords and memorable passphrases, a strength test, and a breach check that never sends your password.
  • Word Counter With Character Limits for X, LinkedIn, SMS and SEO (Plus Text Clean-Up). Words, characters, reading time, limits for X, LinkedIn, SMS and SEO, and one-tap text clean-up.

How to Tell Whether an Online Tool Is Really Free and Private

  • Try the download first. Before typing anything real, make a test version and download it. If the download asks for payment or an account, leave.
  • Look for "no upload" or "processed in your browser". Better still, load the page, turn off your internet connection and see whether it still works.
  • Read what happens after a trial. Dynamic QR codes, e-signature sends and "pro" exports often stop or start charging when the trial ends.
  • Don't upload ID, contracts or medical records to any site that processes files on its own servers, whatever its privacy page says.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are these tools really free?

Yes. There is no account, trial, watermark or usage limit. The site is supported by ordinary advertising on the article pages, not by charging for the tools.

Do the tools upload my files?

No. Files are processed in your browser and never leave your device. The only network requests load the tools' own code, plus the optional password breach check, which sends only a 5-character partial fingerprint.

Do they work on phones?

Yes, in Safari on iPhone and Chrome on Android, as well as on computers. Very large PDFs or hundreds of photos are faster on a computer.

Can I use them for my business?

Yes. QR codes, invoices, signed documents and everything else you make are yours to use commercially.

Will you add more tools?

Yes. We add tools for the jobs people tell us are hardest to do for free and in private.
